name: Tomisato (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Tomisato city emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised bird with raised wings.
history: Municipal flag of Tomisato, a city in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 14 September 2011; the emblem dates from 1 April 1969.

features.role: Tomisato city emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised bird with raised wings
